At `0x5D4D20`, three successive `outer+0x68`, `outer+4`, `[outer+4]+0x1C` pointer gates produce -1 on a missing dependency, otherwise initialize fields and return 0. The successful-core path of wrapper `0x5D5BD0` executes `0x5D5BFB -> 0x5D4D20` but overwrites EAX with zero, and callers `0x5CF970/0x5CFA10` locally check wrapper status before state 4.
